name: Binary Search IsoSurface Extraction
definition: Approximates the position of an isosurface between two sample points (left and right) by iteratively halving the interval based on scalar field values.
summary: Binary Search IsoSurface Extraction is a ray-tracing method that locates isosurface intersections by iteratively halving the interval between bracketing sample points, offering robustness to non-linear field variations unlike analytical methods.
